idea-plugin.name: Sunday Agent
idea-plugin.description:
Sunday Agent for JetBrains IDEs — chat with the Sunday agent, send selections, and explain code, powered by your local per-user sundayd daemon.

Requires a running sundayd daemon (shared with the Sunday CLI and VS Code extension). The plugin attaches to ~/.sunday/sundayd.sock (Windows: \\.\pipe\sundayd-<user>) or spawns sundayd from PATH / SUNDAY_DAEMON_PATH.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0 — Initial JetBrains frontend: Sunday tool window with streaming chat, "Send selection to Sunday" and "Explain code" editor actions, all backed by the shared per-user sundayd daemon over the existing socket protocol.

action.description: Open the Sunday agent chat tool window
Send the current selection to Sunday chat
Ask Sunday to explain the selected code
